tldr: AutoML-Agent is a novel multi-agent LLM framework that automates the full AutoML pipeline from data retrieval to model deployment using retrieval-augmented planning, parallel specialized agents, and multi-stage verification.
contributions: First task-agnostic LLM-based AutoML framework spanning from data retrieval to model deployment
Retrieval-augmented planning with role-specific plan decomposition and prompting-based execution to handle planning complexity
Structure-based prompt parsing and multi-stage verification to improve implementation accuracy
Extensive experiments on seven downstream tasks using fourteen datasets demonstrating superior full-pipeline automation
methods: AutoML-Agent coordinates multiple specialized LLM agents: an Agent Manager orchestrates the pipeline, a Prompt Agent parses user instructions into standardized JSON, a Data Agent handles dataset retrieval and preprocessing, a Model Agent performs training-free model search and hyperparameter optimization, and an Operation Agent writes and verifies executable code. The framework uses retrieval-augmented planning to generate multiple end-to-end plans in parallel, decomposes each plan into role-specific subtasks, and applies multi-stage verification between steps to ensure correctness before final code implementation.
results: Experiments on seven downstream tasks using fourteen datasets show that AutoML-Agent achieves a higher success rate in automating the full AutoML process and yields systems with good performance across diverse domains, compared to existing frameworks that are limited to specific pipeline steps or task types.
limitations: LLM code generation may produce hallucinations including code incompleteness, incorrect or missing dependencies, and undiscovered bugs
Ambiguous user task descriptions can lead to poor code generation outcomes
Inter-step dependencies in the full pipeline create an enlarged search space
Existing related frameworks only cover limited subsets of the AutoML pipeline rather than end-to-end
